Geographies Served Programs Universe 2 U State Karnataka States Karnataka For the kids, this programme is a window to the outside world. Visits are planned to the science fairs, parks, and museums. They have the chance to take part in workshops and projects and listen to prominent scientists from around the world. This exposes children to science outside of the classroom. Reading State Karnataka States Karnataka We help the kids develop the habit of reading every day. We are aware that underprivileged families' children experience less of the outside world and have fewer possibilities to travel. They get an understanding of life outside of their daily lives through books. Reading regularly gives kids a language advantage and serves as a bridge to mainstream society. Music State Karnataka States Karnataka We wish to have a significant impact on the children's life by exposing them to Indian and global cultures. Music is a form of therapy as well as a hobby. At all of our Centres, children are taught classical music and instruments by Dr. L. Subramaniam and vocalist Kavita Krishnamurti. We also collaborate with SPIC MACAY, a nonpartisan national voluntary movement that hosts events including screenings of classic films, walks through history, folk arts, crafts, yoga, and classical music and dance.
